note: Expert review of 24 high-traffic groups. Removals are dead/off-topic items; fit changes are strictness calls. Contains unverified judgment calls listed in docs/group-review.md. Destin/Claude overrides: Arch and CachyOS keep "full"; Proton Mail/Pass not added (closed servers). Additions moved into data/starter.json. YouCoded keeps Windows/Mac/Linux/Android: its browser access is only on your own network, not a public web app.

summary.onlyoffice-docs: ONLYOFFICE Docs is an office suite for documents, spreadsheets, presentations and forms that several people can edit together, and it opens Microsoft Office files well. You run it on your own server, or use ONLYOFFICE's separate free desktop app.
summary.postmarketos: postmarketOS is a Linux-based operating system for phones, built to keep older devices useful for many years. It is for tinkerers: on most phones, calls, the camera or mobile data do not fully work yet.
summary.delta-chat: Delta Chat is a messaging app for phones and computers that sends chats and files through ordinary email accounts. It lets you reach anyone with email, without relying on a single company's chat service.
summary.ollama: Ollama is a free tool that runs AI models on your own computer, so your chats stay on your machine. It now has a simple chat window, and other apps can also use it to run models.
summary.continue: Continue is an AI coding helper for VS Code, JetBrains and the terminal. The project has been shut down and is read-only, so it no longer gets updates.
summary.openhands: OpenHands is a tool for starting and managing AI coding assistants on your own computer or server. It is for programmers who want to run several AI helpers and trigger them from tools like Slack and GitHub.
summary.openassistant: OpenAssistant was a community project to build an open AI chat assistant. It ended in 2024, and its main lasting result is a public set of training data.
summary.gnumeric: Gnumeric is a lightweight spreadsheet program for tables, formulas and statistics. It is mainly for Linux, and is fast but has fewer chart options than LibreOffice.
summary.cal-com: Cal.diy is the free community edition of Cal.com, which lets you share a page where others pick a meeting time. It is for people running their own server, and the makers advise it for personal use only.
summary.aliasvault: AliasVault is a password manager that also creates a random email address for each website, so your real address stays private. It works in the browser, as phone apps and on your own server.
summary.affine: AFFiNE is a workspace that combines documents, whiteboards and tables in one app, in the style of Notion. Your notes are stored on your own device by default, and you can host it yourself.
summary.notegen: NoteGen is an app for collecting notes, links, images and recordings and organizing them into Markdown notes, with optional AI help. Your notes stay as plain files on your computer or phone.
